items.name: Mixed salad greens (red leaf lettuce, arugula, frisée)
Roasted/sliced red vegetable (likely beet or tomato)

scale_cues: Large square white dinner plate (~28-30 cm side) used as scale; the salad covers roughly 10 x 9 cm in the upper-right part of the plate, about a third of the plate's width.
assumptions: The leafy pile is mostly low-density mixed greens (about 0.1 g/cm³ for loose leaves), so its weight is low even though it looks large.
The reddish-brown slab under the greens on the left is a roasted beet or tomato. If it is smoked salmon or seared tuna, add about 40-60 kcal and 6-10 g protein.
The dark bits in the center are chopped black olives (or possibly blackberries).
The glossy sheen suggests an oil-based vinaigrette at about 4.5 kcal/g.
No drink or bread is visible.
